nodes.name: Sunlight
nodes.desc: Strong high-altitude sunlight powers the grasses, heath and lobelia of the plateau, though nights bring frost.

nodes.name: Seasonal rains
nodes.desc: Summer rains and hail feed the highland grasslands that geladas graze; the dry season brings frost and thin forage.

nodes.name: Highland soil
nodes.desc: Nutrients recycled from dead plants and dung in the cool plateau soil feed the grasses, heath and lobelia.

nodes.name: Soil microbes and fungi
nodes.desc: Break down dead plants, dung and carcasses, returning nutrients to the highland soil.

nodes.name: Highland grasses
nodes.desc: Montane and afroalpine grasslands cover much of the plateau and are the main food of geladas.

nodes.name: Giant lobelia
nodes.desc: A tall rosette plant of the afroalpine zone, one of the park's signature plants.

nodes.name: Tree heath
nodes.desc: A shrub-tree of the heath belt; walia ibex are known to reach up for young heath shoots.

nodes.name: Everlasting shrubs
nodes.desc: Shrubby everlastings of the highlands; their spread into rodent habitat is listed as a pressure on the Ethiopian wolf.

nodes.name: Gelada
nodes.desc: A grazing primate of the Ethiopian Highlands, with grass blades making up most of its diet; it sleeps on cliff ledges.

nodes.name: Walia ibex
nodes.desc: An endemic wild goat of steep cliffs that browses shrubs, herbs, lichens and grasses; Simien is its main stronghold.

nodes.name: Klipspringer
nodes.desc: A small antelope of rocky ground, recorded in the park.

nodes.name: Bushbuck
nodes.desc: A browsing antelope; the Menelik's form is endemic to the Ethiopian Highlands.

nodes.name: Rock hyrax
nodes.desc: A small herbivore living among rocks, listed among the park's small mammals.

nodes.name: Abyssinian grass rat
nodes.desc: A rodent of the highland grasslands and the main prey of the Ethiopian wolf in Simien.

nodes.name: Ethiopian wolf
nodes.desc: A rare canid that specialises in afroalpine rodents; Simien holds its second-largest population.

nodes.name: African golden wolf
nodes.desc: A generalist canid that competes with Ethiopian wolves and can displace them from carcasses.

nodes.name: Augur buzzard
nodes.desc: A raptor of highland open country, recorded often in the park.

nodes.name: Bearded vulture
nodes.desc: Feeds mainly on bone and marrow, dropping large bones onto rocks to break them; it also takes some live prey.

nodes.name: Thick-billed raven
nodes.desc: A large highland raven that is commonly seen in the park.

nodes.name: Leopard
nodes.desc: A solitary cat; it is among the observed predators of geladas and a predator of walia ibex.

nodes.name: Spotted hyena
nodes.desc: A predator and scavenger that is among the observed predators of geladas and walia ibex.
